_comment: Support route state, kept out of the page markup so a route can be turned on by editing data, not layout. pages/vex-support.html renders every route's honest pending state statically — that is what a visitor with no JavaScript sees, and it is the correct default. widgets/vex-institutional.js reads this file and upgrades a route to a live action ONLY when status is ACTIVE and url is a real string. A route with a null url can never render a button, so there is no way for an unverified destination to reach a visitor. See docs/architecture/18-institutional-pages.md.
publicationRule: Never render an unverified route as an active payment action. A route becomes ACTIVE only after every entry in its requiredBeforePublication list is genuinely satisfied — not when the list is deleted.

routes.note: Zelle is the only route that can receive support today and is currently Victor's only form of income. The receiving detail is deliberately absent: this repository must not guess, infer, or reconstruct it, and Victor's phone number is not published by default.
requiredBeforePublication: Confirm the intended personal receiving account
Complete a trusted small test transfer
Supply a public-safe QR asset or a dedicated enrolled email
Do not expose Victor's phone number by default

routes.note: GitHub Sponsors requires a completed public presence before approval, and approval carries its own review period. Once live it takes no platform cut, which is why the tier amounts below wait for it rather than being pointed at a processor that would take a percentage. candidateUrl is recorded for verification and is intentionally NOT the url field — nothing renders from candidateUrl.
requiredBeforePublication: Confirm the public profile resolves for a logged-out visitor
Confirm published tier amounts and welcome language

routes.note: Commercial engagements are a separate door from personal sponsorship. No support meaning promises any commercial deliverable, and this route must stay visually distinct from the two personal routes.
requiredBeforePublication: Victor selects the business inquiry destination
The page continues to distinguish engagement from sponsorship

tierAmounts.confirmedBy: Victor, 2026-07-31 — keep the figures, remove the links until GitHub Sponsors is live.

legacyStripeLinks.reason: The architecture now separates Victor's personal open-source support from Vextreme LLC engagements, and every active destination must be re-verified independently. A link appearing on the legacy page is not evidence that it is still correct.

capacityFigures.reason: Founder-reported amounts have not been reconciled against current lender statements, one figure was tied to a date that had already passed when it was supplied, and one total has ambiguous component scope that risks double-counting. The stage ladder on the page therefore carries state, not numbers.
